description: Golden vectors for DscpProbePacket (pkt_t=0x03, ver=0x01). 26 bytes on wire. See contracts/packets/dscp_probe.md for field definitions. Layout: pkt_t(1) + ver(1) + flow_id(4) + seq(8) + send_mono_ns(8) + dscp_intended_ul(1) + dscp_actual_ul(1) + dscp_intended_dl(1) + _pad(1).

cases.name: first_send_ef
cases.notes: UE first send with DSCP EF (46=0x2E). dscp_actual_ul and dscp_intended_dl are 0xFF (server has not yet echoed).

cases.name: echo_ef_stripped
cases.notes: Server echo: UE intended DSCP EF (46) but server received DSCP 0 (operator stripped). Server marks echo with EF (dscp_intended_dl=46).

cases.name: echo_ef_preserved
cases.notes: Server echo: UE sent DSCP EF (46) and server also received EF — operator is transparent in both directions.
